Why is this correspondence and not a retail communication?

It is correspondence: it is distributed to 1 retail investor within a 30-calendar-day period, which is 25 or fewer, so it meets the 2210(a)(2) definition. Correspondence does not require registered-principal approval before use and is excluded from the filing requirements (2210(c)(7)(J)); it is supervised under Rule 3110(b) and 3110.06–.09, typically through risk-based post-use review, and must be retained under 4511 / SEA 17a-4. Watch the count: if the same template reaches more than 25 retail investors in any 30-day window it becomes a retail communication and pre-approval applies.
